arStrings.szText: Elite enemies have a chance to drop {icon:Reliquary_BerserkCurrency, 1.8} Behelits when slain. Collect and use them to claim Berserk themed cosmetics. Claim all rewards to unlock the {icon:ReliquaryDetails_BonusIcon, 2.0} Bonus reward.
